title: Internal JWT claims (C2)
description: Payload of the ES256 JWT issued by the gateway for MCP servers and the credential broker. Rules that a schema cannot express and that receivers MUST check: kid not starting with 'test-' unless the receiver is explicitly configured with allowTestKeys=true (dev/test only, CC-044), signature against the gateway JWKS, iss, aud == own id, exp with clock skew <= 30 s, iat not more than 30 s in the future, exp - iat <= 60 s, jti not seen within its validity window, rid == X-Request-Id header, tool present and == params.name for tools/call, tool present for the broker resolve and for the authenticator calls of the gateway (GET /v1/authenticator, POST /v1/authenticator/verify, POST /v1/authenticator/invalidate-codes; CC-092, CC-128), tool absent for every other request (CC-038), service variant only for initialize, server/discover, tools/list, ping, GET /mcp-manifest and (broker) GET /v1/systems, and only outside a session (stateless, CC-070): notifications/*, GET/DELETE on the MCP endpoint, subscriptions/listen and every other request of a session carry the user variant without tool. A tools/call retry with inputResponses (MRTR, MCP 2026-07-28) is an ordinary tools/call with a fresh token (CC-069). Any failure -> HTTP 401.

Header.description: JOSE header. Receivers accept only ES256 and only a kid present in the gateway JWKS; a kid starting with 'test-' is rejected unless allowTestKeys=true (CC-044).

aud.description: Id of the receiving component: mcp-<system> or mcp-credential-broker. A single string, never an array.

prv.description: Policy revision of the gateway (C7). 00000000000000-0000000 means a gateway without a loaded bundle (M1 only); receivers must not infer anything about policy from it (CC-068).

UserClaims.description: Call on behalf of a user. The only variant accepted for tools/call and by the broker resolve and authenticator endpoints.

sub.description: sub from the IdP token (C1), unchanged.

grp.description: User groups from C9, only those with the mcp- prefix.

azp.description: OAuth client id of the AI client (C1).

vsc.description: Narrowing of the virtual server (CC-027): resourceDefaults of the link mapped to the vsScopes fields of the Cedar model. Present exactly when vs is present; {} when the link does not narrow resources. Servers build context.vsScopes from it.

tool.description: Server-side name of the tool being called. Present exactly for tools/call (and for the broker resolve and authenticator calls that serve it); absent for initialize, server/discover, subscriptions/listen, tools/list, ping and GET /mcp-manifest (CC-038, CC-069).

mfa.description: Seconds since the last authentication at an MFA acr level. Absent means unknown.

ServiceClaims.description: Gateway call without a user and without a session. Accepted only for initialize, server/discover, tools/list, ping and GET /mcp-manifest (CC-069, CC-070).
